units.source_text: 棋下毕了，听见衣服窸窣之声，看来是散场了。

en.t: When the game of go was over, he heard the rustle of clothing; it seemed the gathering was breaking up.

units.source_text: 一个侍女叫道：“小少爷哪里去了？

en.t: One of the serving women called out, "Where has the young master gone?

units.source_text: 我把这格子门关上了吧。”

en.t: I suppose I should close this lattice door."
Then came the sound of the door being shut.

units.source_text: 过了一会，源氏公子对小君说：“都已睡静了。

en.t: After a while, Prince Genji said to Kogimi, "Everyone has settled down and gone quiet.

units.source_text: 你就到她那里去，给我好好地办成功吧！”

en.t: Go to her now, and make sure you bring this off properly for me!"

units.source_text: 小君心中想：“姐姐这个人的脾气是坚贞不拔的，我无法说服她。

en.t: Kogimi thought to himself, "My sister is steadfast by nature, and I cannot persuade her.

units.source_text: 还不如不要告诉她，等人少的时候把公子带进她房间里去吧。”

en.t: It would be better not to tell her, but to wait until there are fewer people and lead the prince into her room."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“纪伊守的妹妹也在这里么？

en.t: Prince Genji said, "Is the Governor of Kii's younger sister here too?
Let me have a little look at her."
Kogimi answered, "How could that possibly be done?

units.source_text: 格子门里面遮着帷屏呢。”

en.t: There is a curtain screen set up inside the lattice door."
Prince Genji thought, "So it is just as I expected.
But I have already caught sight of her."

units.source_text: 心中觉得好笑，又想：“我不告诉他吧。

en.t: He found it amusing, and then thought, "I had better not tell him.

units.source_text: 告诉了他，对不起那个女子。”

en.t: If I told him, it would be unfair to that woman."

units.source_text: 只是反复地说：“等到夜深，心焦得很！”

en.t: He only kept repeating, "Waiting until the night grows late makes me terribly impatient!"
